subject: Marketplace partner implementation — MSA / DPA / SOW redlines & timeline
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Alice King <alice.king@nimbus-integrations.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace partner implementation — MSA / DPA / SOW redlines & timeline

Hi Alice,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the Nimbus marketplace flow looks promising. Per our conversation, attached are three artifacts to kick off legal/procurement: a redline of the Nimbus MSA (Nimbus_MSA_Redlines_v1.pdf), our draft SOW for the marketplace connector (RI_SOW_Draft_Marketplace.docx), and a short security evidence summary we maintain for partners (security-evidence-summary.pdf).

High-level asks from our side:
- Review the MSA redlines (high priority: liability cap, indemnity carve outs for third-party data processing, and the subcontractor/subprocessor approval flow).
- Confirm whether Nimbus can accept Redwood's proposed DPA appendix; if not, please flag specific clauses (data residency, deletion timelines, subprocessors).
- Review SOW scope and call out any constraints on sampling/usage metrics or custom work we should price separately.

Proposed timeline: 1) Nimbus sends counter-redlines by Tue 3/30, 2) Legal alignment call Wed 3/31, 3) Target DocuSign by Fri 4/2 so we can hit April marketplace onboarding.

If your legal/procurement folks need a mutual action plan, Ben and Vanessa are looped and can coordinate.

Thanks — looking forward to progress.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Sr. Partner Lead, Strategic Alliances
Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

Attachments: Nimbus_MSA_Redlines_v1.pdf, RI_SOW_Draft_Marketplace.docx, security-evidence-summary.pdf
From: Alice King <alice.king@nimbus-integrations.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Nimbus Legal <legal@nimbus-integrations.com>, procurement@nimbus-integrations.com
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace partner implementation — MSA / DPA / SOW redlines & timeline

Hi Mina,

Appreciate the materials — sharing with our legal and procurement teams now. Quick notes from our side after a first pass (we are attaching a tracked PDF):

- Liability / Indemnity: We are generally comfortable with commercial limitations, but our counsel requests a clarification in Section 9 on intellectual property carveouts and asks for a mutual indemnity for third-party claims related to breach of the DPA.
- Data residency: Nimbus is open to supporting EU/regional routing, but we need clearer language on where Redwood will store marketplace metadata vs. customer data; propose an appendix that enumerates regions.
- Subprocessors: Our procurement team prefers a 30-day notice plus an objection right for critical subprocessors; can Redwood accept a 30-day prior notice window (we see you requested 10 days)?
- SLA credits: We can accept a 99.5% uptime target for the connector, but we need clarity on how credits are calculated for multi-tenant vs dedicated customers.

We attached Nimbus_Counterredlines.pdf — most changes are commentary and a handful of redline edits. We can target the 3/30 counter-redline date, but legal asked for a short call before DocuSign to align on the indemnity language. Are you available Wed 3/31 10:00am PT?

Regards,
Alice King
Head of Partnerships
Nimbus Integrations
alice.king@nimbus-integrations.com | +1 212-555-0199

Attachment: Nimbus_Counterredlines.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace partner implementation — MSA / DPA / SOW redlines & timeline

Mina / Vanessa —

Read Alice's note and the counter-redlines. Quick internal summary and suggested negotiation posture for the call:

1) Indemnity / IP: Redwood will hold to our commercial cap (3x ARR or $5M, whichever is lower) but be flexible on mutual IP carveouts — we can accept mutual indemnity limited to gross negligence or willful misconduct. Ask legal to prepare a 2-line fallback for counterparty counsel.

2) Data residency and subprocessors: We should accept a 30-day notice for non-critical subprocessors and keep 10-day notice only for edge-case, higher-risk subprocessors. For data residency, propose an appendix where Nimbus selects region(s) per marketplace listing; Redwood will confirm capacity regionally but can't guarantee immediate provisioning in all regions — include a provisioning SLAT (service lead time) of 7–14 days.

3) SLA credits: Keep the standard credit calculation (per-tenant monthly aggregate). If Nimbus needs per-listing SLAs for dedicated deployments, price as a premium add-on in the SOW.

4) SOW scope: Flagging the integration deliverables that are out-of-scope (custom ETL, 1:1 UI customizations, multi-tenant billing integration) so procurement can price separately.

Next steps (mutual action plan):
- Today (Mon 3/29): Redwood confirms legal fallback language and prepares an annotated packet for the call.
- Wed 3/31 10:00am PT: Legal alignment call (30m) — attendees: Mina, Ben, Vanessa, Alice, Nimbus legal rep.
- Thu 4/1: Final redlines agreed and DocuSign envelope prepared.
- Fri 4/2: Target signed and onboarding kickoff scheduled.

Vanessa — can you confirm procurement ok with the proposed indemnity cap and SLA fallback? If procurement needs an exec escalation for any carveout, please indicate — we have limited flexibility on cap numbers without C-level sign-off.

Thanks,
Ben
Director, Commercial Partnerships
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alice King <alice.king@nimbus-integrations.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace partner implementation — MSA / DPA / SOW redlines & timeline

Hi Alice — thanks for the quick turnaround and the counterredlines. Procurement side notes:

- We can accept the mutual IP carveouts and the mutual indemnity limited to negligence/willful misconduct as Ben suggested. The commercial cap will stay as discussed (3x ARR / $5M whichever lower) unless Nimbus requires exec approval.
- Regarding subprocessors: Redwood will move to 30-day notice for standard subprocessors and a 10-day notice for any changes that affect data residency or encryption keys; we'll add clearer language to the DPA appendix.
- For data residency: we'll draft an appendix that lists supported regions and an operational provisioning SLAT (7–14 business days) for any region outside our default US/EU clusters.

Action items from procurement perspective:
- Mina: please confirm that Nimbus is comfortable with the 7–14 day provisioning SLAT.
- Alice / Nimbus: please share the specific list of critical subprocessors you want to review (if any) before we finalize the DPA.
- Legal alignment call Wed 3/31 10:00am PT — please share dial-in and attendee list.

If all good, we can prepare the DocuSign envelope post-call. We prefer to receive the final SOW with explicit line items for any premium deliverables (custom ETL, dedicated billing integration).

Thanks — Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Manager, Procurement & Partnerships Operations
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com

Attachment: procurement-checklist.xlsx (referenced)

Subject: Re: Marketplace partner implementation — MSA / DPA / SOW redlines & timeline

Mina / Vanessa / Ben —

Thanks for the clarity and the proposed positions. Nimbus legal is comfortable with the mutual indemnity limited to negligence/willful misconduct (we'll accept that fallback). Procurement confirms they can live with the 7–14 business day provisioning SLAT.

We scheduled the alignment call for Wed 3/31 10:00am PT — dial-in and calendar invite has been sent to all. Also attaching the final counter-redlines where we've accepted most of Redwood's language and annotated two remaining items: one on the indemnity preamble and one on the per-tenant SLA calculation.

Next steps:
- Post-call (Thu 4/1): Nimbus to prepare DocuSign envelope with MSA + DPA + SOW and share link.
- HubSpot reference: https://hubspot.com/deal/NIM-2027-0421 (we've updated expected close date to 2027-04-02).
- Procurment note: Please confirm whether Redwood needs any specific PO or internal purchase order before signing; we will accept electronic signature via DocuSign.

Looking forward to the call.

Best,
